description: This file provides functionality for training machine learning models from uploaded datasets, including data preprocessing, model training (classification/regression), and artifact storage. It defines data models, helper functions, and a public interface for initiating training with uploaded files.

classes.name: TrainingResult
classes.description: Structured result of a training operation, including model ID, storage path, task type, target column, metrics, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: str _infer_task_type(y: pd.Series)
methods.description: Infers if the training task is classification or regression based on target variable properties.

methods.name: Tuple[pd.DataFrame,pd.Series] _prepare_features(df: pd.DataFrame, target_column: str)
methods.description: Preprocesses the dataset to separate features and target, handling missing values and encoding categorical variables.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame _read_uploaded_to_dataframe(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str)
methods.description: Reads uploaded file bytes into a pandas DataFrame supporting CSV and Excel formats.

methods.name: _train_model(X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series, task_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Trains a Random Forest classifier or regressor based on inferred or provided task type, and evaluates model performance.

methods.name: TrainingResult _store_artifact(model, meta: Dict[str, Union[str, int, float]])
methods.description: Stores the trained model using joblib, saves metadata, and returns a TrainingResult instance.

methods.name: TrainingResult train_from_upload( file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, target_column: Optional[str] = None, task_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Public function to train a model from uploaded dataset bytes, handling file reading, preprocessing, training, and storage.
